# Changelog
2 September2 Sep
- ## Gemini 3.8 Flash now available on AI Gateway
Call Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.
Rohan Taneja, Zachary Chen, and 1 other
[Learn more](/changelog/gemini-3-8-flash-now-available-on-ai-gateway)
1 September1 Sep
- ## Qwen 3.8 Max 0902 now available on AI Gateway
Call Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 Max 0902 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.
Zachary Chen, Jerilyn Zheng
[Learn more](/changelog/qwen-3-8-max-0902-now-available-on-ai-gateway)
- ## Claude Fable 5.1 now available on AI Gateway
Call Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.
Rohan Taneja, Jerilyn Zheng
[Learn more](/changelog/claude-fable-5-1-now-available-on-ai-gateway)
- ## AWS PrivateLink is now available on Pro and Enterprise
AWS PrivateLink is now generally available on Vercel. Connect deployments to AWS-hosted databases and services over a private network path.
Miroslav Simulcik, Lakshay Bhushan, and 4 others
[Learn more](/changelog/aws-privatelink-is-now-available-on-pro-and-enterprise)
31 August31 Aug
- ## fx is now available in the AI SDK harness layer
fx is now available in the AI SDK harness layer through the @ai-sdk/harness-fx adapter, built on the ACP harness. Run it through the same HarnessAgent interface.
Felix ArntzSoftware Engineer
[Learn more](/changelog/fx-ai-sdk-harness-adapter)
- ## Set per-user budgets on AI Gateway
AI Gateway budgets now support a user scope. Cap what an individual team member spends through the gateway, alongside team, project, and API key budgets.
Jeremy Philemon, Sam Chitgopekar, and 3 others
[Learn more](/changelog/set-per-user-budgets-on-ai-gateway)
- ## Vercel Sandbox now calculates snapshot storage costs daily
Snapshot Storage is now calculated daily, so every charge maps to the storage you held that day. Pricing is unchanged at $0.08 per GB-month.
Christian Le, Pranav Kanchi, and 2 others
[Learn more](/changelog/vercel-sandbox-now-calculates-snapshot-storage-costs-daily)
30 August30 Aug
- ## MiniMax H3 and H3 Max are 50% off on AI Gateway
MiniMax H3 video generation is 50% off on Vercel AI Gateway through September 13. This applies to both H3 and H3 Max. The model IDs are unchanged, so requests you already send get the discount.
Josh Lipman, Jerilyn Zheng
[Learn more](/changelog/minimax-h3-and-h3-max-are-50-off-on-ai-gateway)
[Show more](/changelog/page/2)
